'''Moonan''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Nen (star)/Legends|Nen]] in the [[Neimoidia system/Legends|Neimoidia system]]. Located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]], it was a toxic rock.
